opening.argument: The presentation is centered on technical instruction, introducing “this session on SQL interview questions” and explaining the different subsets of SQL, including data definition concepts. It also covers user-defined functions, visibly distinguishing scalar, inline table-valued, and multi-statement valued functions. The accompanying course reference describes “This is a 4 Week Instructor-led Online Course,” which is consistent with an ordinary training offering. Although the presentation promotes Edureka and asks viewers to subscribe, the stated material contains no deceptive financial solicitation, credential promise, or payment request connected to that promotion.
